_about: Public-domain John Hales of Eton (1584-1656), 'the ever memorable', for the Word Hoard: the Golden Remains (London 1659) and his Works now first collected (Glasgow: Foulis, 1765, three volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 43 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
